options.content:
**Scope:** Traefik access logs (`traefik.traefik`, JSON on docker stdout) shipped by promtail to Loki. Only `/api/*` traffic on `leaguesphere.app` (host-scoped; other vhosts, demo/stage and subdomain-scan noise excluded) is analysed here.

**Effective window (important):** Docker `local` log driver rotation keeps roughly the **current day** of container logs; Loki retention is 31d (`retention_period: 744h`) but cannot show what Docker already rotated. Treat this dashboard as a **~24h window**. Longer retention / recording rules are a follow-up proposal, not part of this dashboard.

**Query conventions (copied from the Security dashboard):** stream `{job="docker", container="traefik.traefik"}`, structured-metadata filters `| path =~ "…"`, `| user_agent =~ "…"`, `| status =~ "…"`. `ClientHost`, `Duration` (ns), `DownstreamContentSize`, `RouterName` are parsed at query time with field-limited `| json <field>` plus `| __error__=""` (drops truncated lines from Docker log rotation). Endpoint grouping is by `/api/<area>` (first two path segments via `regexp`, honoring Loki 500-series limits — per-ID grouping exceeds them). Go-template `regexReplaceAll` in `label_format` does NOT parse on this Loki and must not be used. Client totals group by fixed UA classes (node / Sideline / browsers / scrapers&probes / other), never by raw `user_agent` (UA diversity exceeds 500 distinct values/day). Healthchecks (`/health`, `/metrics`, `HEAD /`) are already dropped by promtail and excluded here.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="docker", container="traefik.traefik"} | user_agent=~"(?i)^Mozilla.*" | user_agent!~"(?i)(ExternalAgent|SemrushBot|PanguBot|Googlebot|ForestEngine|Claude-SearchBot|Cortex|Palo Alto)" | json RequestHost | __error__="" | RequestHost=~"^(www\\.)?leaguesphere\\.app$" [$__range]))

options.content:
**Normal**
- **Daily snapshot-bot burst:** ~08:0x UTC, UA `node`, one Azure/GH-Actions IP, 1× `/api/gamedays/?format=json&page_size=1000` then ~900× `/api/gamedays/<id>/games/?format=json` in ~3 min. Stat panels §7 read ~1 / ~900. Burst view spikes to ~300 req/min and falls back to ~0.
- **Sideline polling:** UA `Sideline/1.0 (inoffizieller Spielplan-Client)`, low steady rate on `/api/gamedays/?search=season:2026&page_size=500` and `/games/`. No bursts.
- **Browsers:** `Mozilla/*` spread across many ClientHosts, low per-IP rate, mixed endpoints, 2xx-dominated. (Note: `ClientHost` is the Docker gateway IP behind Traefik, so per-client distinction comes from the UA classes above, not from IPs.)

**Deserves a look**
- A **new UA** (or new ClientHost) bursting >100 req/min, esp. on `/api/gamedays*/games/`.
- **429 spikes** (§4): rate limiting is engaging — check whether it is the known bot (tune limits?) or an unknown client.
- **5xx spikes**: nginx/gunicorn/Django upstream problem, not client behaviour — check LeagueSphere logs.
- **p95 regression** on `/api/gamedays*/games/` (§5) or payload jump (§6): serialization / page_size / DB regression.

**Alert proposals (OUT OF SCOPE for this task — candidates only)**
1. `burst>100/min by unknown UA for 5m` (Loki metric query on §3, exclude `node`+`Sideline`).
2. `5xx rate on /api/* > threshold for 5m` (match the existing `traefik_service_requests_total{code=~"5.."}` Prometheus alerts).
3. `p95(/api/gamedays*/games/) > SLO (e.g. 2× baseline) for 15m` (recording rule on §5 quantiles; needs longer retention first).
